question: Asetek parent company owner
markdown:
Asetek, a Danish hardware manufacturer known for liquid cooling and SimSports, was acquired by CQXA Holdings, a subsidiary of Suzhou Chunqiu Electronic Technology, in April 2026 for about $82 million. CQXA owns roughly 90-95.3% of Asetek, taking it private and delisting it from Nasdaq Copenhagen. Founder André Eriksen remains CEO, and the SimSports division continues.
Asetek's parent company is CQXA Holdings Pte. Ltd., a subsidiary of the Chinese consumer electronics firm Suzhou Chunqiu Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
The acquisition of Asetek by CQXA Holdings was completed in April 2026 for approximately $82 million.
CQXA Holdings owns roughly 90% to 95.3% of Asetek.
The acquisition took Asetek private, delisting the company from the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange.
Founder André Eriksen remains the CEO of Asetek.
Asetek is a Danish hardware manufacturer best known for its sealed liquid cooling products.
Asetek's SimSports racing division will continue under the new ownership.
